overall: The AG found the Falmouth Committee on Accessory Apartment was not a public body under the Open Meeting Law, because it was not empowered to act collectively, so no violation occurred; no orders issued.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Falmouth Accessory Apartment committee held a May 9, 2018 meeting closed to the public, violating the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Committee is not a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law and therefore did not violate the law by holding a meeting that was not open to the public.

allegations.summary: Whether the committee fell within the Connelly exception for committees advising a single official was raised but not decided.
allegations.key_passage: Because we decide that the Committee is not a public body, we need not reach the question of whether the Committee would fall within the Connelly exception.
